profile.reading:
The GVTC facility recorded in this registry sits on Overlook Parkway in far north Bexar County, Texas -- part of the Stone Oak/Timberwood Park area northeast of Loop 1604, inside the Hill Country territory GVTC has served with fiber since the 2000s. Bexar County Appraisal District parcel records confirm the tract is owned by Guadalupe Valley Telephone Cooperative Inc -- GVTC's full legal name -- resolving the ownership question this profile could not otherwise settle. But the same parcel record makes clear what kind of site this is: it covers just 0.18 acres and carries an assessed improvement value of $82, figures far too small to represent a data center or even a modest equipment building. That combination -- a fractional-acre parcel with negligible improvement value, owned outright by a rural telephone cooperative -- is the property-tax signature of a small outdoor utility structure: most plausibly a remote fiber terminal, equipment cabinet, or similar unmanned network node feeding GVTC's fiber-to-the-home buildout in this part of its territory, rather than a staffed facility housing servers for lease or even for internal computing.

GVTC itself -- founded in 1951 as the first phone provider in the Hill Country north of San Antonio, and headquartered at 36101 FM 3159 in New Braunfels -- is a member-owned telecommunications cooperative, not a data center or cloud company. Its public-facing services are residential and business internet, TV, phone, and security monitoring, plus wholesale Carrier Ethernet and fiber-to-the-tower products for other carriers; its own marketing materials describe extending fiber optic infrastructure north of San Antonio in the 2000s, which lines up geographically with a small facility in this part of Bexar County, but nowhere does GVTC publicize a data center or colocation offering, in Bexar County or elsewhere. County records show GVTC owns several other small Bexar County parcels nearby along Fair Oaks Parkway and Borgfeld Drive in the same corridor, all similarly modest in improvement value, consistent with a distributed network of small outside-plant sites supporting last-mile fiber and copper service rather than a centralized data hall.

Given the parcel evidence, the most defensible public description of this address is that it is GVTC network infrastructure -- almost certainly outside-plant equipment supporting fiber or telephone service in this part of the cooperative's territory -- rather than a data center in the commercial or hyperscale sense that term usually carries. No source, public or from GVTC itself, publishes IT capacity, square footage, or tenancy information for this site, and the county's own improvement valuation indicates there is very little building here to describe.

profile.research_note:
Company confirmed as regional fiber ISP. No data center or colocation offering found on operator own site; Bexar County facility classification unconfirmed.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] GVTC is an award-winning fiber optics communications provider headquartered at 36101 FM 3159 in New Braunfels, Texas, delivering internet, digital TV, phone service, and security monitoring to residential and commercial customers across Boerne, Bulverde, New Braunfels, and other parts of the far north San Antonio, Hill Country, Canyon Lake, Spring Branch, and South-Central Texas region. The companys own site, as fetched during this research session, describes only these residential and commercial communications services and makes no mention of a data center facility or colocation offering anywhere in its service area, including Bexar County, where this registry records a GVTC facility. This registry could not confirm whether the Bexar County record reflects a genuine data center, a network central office or point of presence supporting GVTCs fiber network, or a misattributed facility, so it is recorded as exhausted pending a source that specifically addresses GVTCs infrastructure facilities rather than its consumer-facing service offerings.

reading.body:
GVTC is a regional fiber internet service provider in central Texas, and the Bexar County facility on this registry could not be confirmed as a data center. The operator's published materials describe only residential and commercial communications services. Whether this Bexar County location is a data center, a network hub supporting GVTC's fiber operations, or a misattribution remains unresolved after research exhaustion.

No IT capacity specifications are published for this facility. The research note indicates GVTC's own website makes no mention of a data center offering in any part of its service area.

This facility cannot be ranked against published data center capacity in Texas. Of 133 mapped facilities in the state, only 18 have published megawatt figures totaling 468 MW. No power specification for this location allows comparison to that subset.
